data.exact_reserve_text: The following tables show the development of gross and net claims incurred including IBNR and the claims handling provision over the last six years. Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 0.8m (2015: surplus of GBP 1.0m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 308 experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 0.2 million, representing a 1.97% increase in opening gross reserves. This adverse development is calculated from the gross claims development triangle for underwriting years 2011 to 2014. The report also notes a net surplus of GBP 0.8 million from the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years, which contradicts the gross triangle calculation.
raw_causal_phrases: reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is calculated from the gross claims development triangle. The narrative mentions a net surplus of GBP 0.8m for previous accident years, which contradicts the gross strengthening derived from the triangle. The claims development triangle is for cumulative claims incurred at different development stages, not cumulative payments or outstanding reserves directly.
